claim_a.full_claim: Despite 16 years of mechanism discovery, SIBO treatment efficacy improved only modestly: rifaximin's 44% response rate in TARGET 3 (2015) is not dramatically better than neomycin's 35% response in the 2003 study. The real advance is in treatment specificity (gas-type matching) and prevention (prokinetic optimization), not in treatment efficacy.

claim_b.evidence: Ch3. These remedies are based on clinical experience and traditional use rather than RCT data. Peppermint oil has the strongest evidence (calcium channel blocker mechanism, multiple IBS trials). Iberogast (STW 5) has some clinical trial evidence for functional dyspepsia.
